Name: Tool Upgrade Bundles
Author: Pixeltica
Description:
[img]https://file.garden/aZnNi5K8pRGSceNM/tubs/tubs_banner_v3.png[/img]
[center][i][Image: Tool Upgrade Bundles Banner][/i][/center]
[center][b][size=3]Happy 10th Anniversary Stardew Valley![/size]
[/b][/center]
In my own celebration of this amazing milestone both for Stardew and myself (as according to Nexus I've been playing AND modding Stardew since March 2016 as well!?) I've created a little something I've been hoping to do for a while. Bundles are my absolute favourite part of the game - I love collecting things for them - be it Community Centre, the Raccoon Family, or any of the amazing custom bundles made by the incredible modding community! 

[center][size=4][b]Welcome to Tool Upgrade Bundles 2.0!
[/b][/size][/center]
This mod changes things up by removing all the tool upgrades from Clint's shop, and instead moves them to a little inner cave room on your farm. Small dusty helpers on are on hand to help you improve your tools as you progress and complete the various bundles!

Notable changes: I have decided to include the fishing rods as upgradable tools as well - as of 2.0 you will start with a Training Rod and upgrade to Bamboo, Fiberglass and then Iridium.

[b][color=#38761d]IMPORTANT: YOU WILL NEED TO SLEEP AT LEAST ONCE FOR MOST SETTING CHANGES TO APPLY![/color][/b]

[left][b][size=4][b][size=2][size=4]MAJOR CHANGES IN 2.0![/size][/size][/b][/size][/b][/left]
- You can turn vanilla upgrades at the Blacksmith on or off at any time
- You can turn on rods being sold at the Fish Shop at any time
- You can switch between Custom and Vanilla bundles mid-game
- You can choose how many items are required for Custom Bundles (3, 4, or all 5)
- You can customize the price multiplier for common and rare items in Custom Bundles
- You can customize the money AND metal bar multiplier in Vanilla Bundles as well
- You can customize both the upgrade price multiplier AND the actual trade-in item
- Chinese (ZH) translation is now included with the main mod

Most bundles have been rebalanced and many had their required items adjusted - there are now multiple "ANY OF...." types of options where you can submit one of of multiple possible items, allowing for options for each season and bringing in more variety.

[b][color=#b45f06]WARNING: ONLY When upgrading from any old version 1.x.x to 2.x.x  UPGRADE WILL REMOVE ANY ITEMS CONTRIBUTED TO UNFINISHED BUNDLES!  [/color]
[/b]
Because the mod was pretty much rewritten from ground up, removing all dependency on Clint's Upgrades, due to the many changes it means any bundles that have not yet been completed will be automatically updated to the new versions. Any already completed bundles will be automatically migrated and won't need to be completed again but any incomplete bundles will be reset (use the customization settings to temporarily reduce the required number of items to make up for the loss, or open the bundle page and type in [u]ub purchase[/u] in the SMAPI console to instantly unlock it in case of issues)[/left]
[center][/center]
[center][b][color=#38761d][size=4]You can add this mod any time during the playthrough as you do NOT need to complete the bundles for any tools you already have and can just start at the next tier! You will be able to upgrade any existing tools as long as you have them in your inventory![/size][/color]

[/b] [/center]

[center][img]https://file.garden/aZnNi5K8pRGSceNM/tubs/tubs_bundles.png[/img]﻿
[i][Image: Bundles Banner][/i][/center]

[center]There are two types of bundles available:[/center]
[b]CUSTOM BUNDLES [/b]- those are designed by myself, each bundle requiring 5 different items, 1 of them is always raw ore corresponding to the tier of the update. I tried to make them as balanced as possible in terms of progression but they likely will be a bit more challenging than just breezing through with cash and metal bars!

[b]VANILLA BUNDLES[/b] - if you just want to benefit from the upgrades being accessible around the clock, as well as being instant on completion, you can change them to the vanilla variant - each bundle will ask for pretty much exactly the same items/cash as Clint would (with some minor adjustments). As of 2.0 you can also customize the multiplier that's applied to Vanilla Bundles to make them easier or harder, whichever you prefer.

When a bundle is completed it permanently unlocks the ability to upgrade that tool at the anvil for a small "fee/snack" for the helpers - so for example if you happen to loose your fishing rod, or the mines glitch your pickaxe, etc, you will not have to pay for the upgrades again, just bring your un-upgraded tool back to the anvil and the helpers will be happy to swap them out again!

[center][img]https://file.garden/aZnNi5K8pRGSceNM/tubs/tubs_compatibility.png[/img]﻿
[i][Image: Compatibility Banner][/i][/center]

I've done my best at making the entryway to the cave room as compatible with modded farm caves as possible, though of course I cannot guarantee covering every single one. See below the list of modded farm caves I have personally tested.

IMPORTANT: for some of the caves, due to their design, it was not possible to place the entryway in a way that fit, in those cases the door may automatically be relocated to the mine entrance, next to the elevator.

Where possible I have also tried to provide an alternative location if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14109]Additional Farm Cave[/url] installed.

The mod should also be compatible with any additional modded tools (i.e. Prismatic Tools, Love of Cooking, etc) if you have any modded tools that normally get upgraded at Clint's he will still have those available as normal - only vanilla tools have been modified to be handled via bundles.

You can now also set a completely manual override location by providing the location name, and X and Y tile coordinates expand the below instructions for more details:

[spoiler]

[center][size=5][b]How to set your own custom location for the door to the Tool Upgrade Cave[/b][/size][/center]

You can enable a manual override in the mod settings - this will completely bypass any automatic vanilla or modded cave detection and will instead use the location name and the X and Y tile positions you provide in the config.

IMPORTANT: when you enable the manual override you MUST restart the game fully for the bundle to relocate as it's location is passed to the Unlockable Bundles only once when the game loads. If changed the manual override details and the bundle is not there even though the door is visible it is likely because the game needs to be restarted for the new coordinates to take effect.

[img]https://file.garden/aZnNi5K8pRGSceNM/tubs/tubs_custom_location_gmcm.png[/img]
[center][Image: GMCM Configuration Screen][/center]
For the location name you HAVE to provide the internal location name which the game recognizes. For example the farm cave location name is "FarmCave", the shortcut between the Farm and the Mountain is "Backwoods", etc. Below is a quick list of most common vanilla locations.

Farm - anywhere on the farm
FarmCave - the default farm cave (some farms come with secondary caves, like WaFF/LE farms - you'll need to use the Debug Mode mod mentioned below to get the exact location name for those)
Backwoods - shortcut between farm and Mountain
Mountain - map where Robin's House is
Mine - the main entrance of the mines
Town - main Pelican Town map

I highly recommend using the Debug Mode mod (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/679) -  to pick your own exact X & Y tile positions. Enabling it in game will give you both the location name in the format the mod needs, and the exact X & Y coordinates of where your mouse pointer is at. This will also give you any modded location names if you'd like to place the door on a non-vanilla map.

NOTE: the Door is a 3x3 tile map that is overlaid on existing map - the X & Y tiles are the TOP-LEFT corner tile coordinates:


[img]https://file.garden/aZnNi5K8pRGSceNM/tubs/tubs_custom_location_mountain.png[/img]
[center][Image: Debug Mode used on the Mountain Map][/center]
[/spoiler]
